question:
A local Helm chart for the observatory's sky-map frontend is stored at `/home/candidate/exam/q1/orrery` (the chart names its Deployment after the release). In namespace `starmap`, the release `orrery-north` was installed from this chart and then upgraded to an image tag that does not exist, so its new Pods cannot start.

1. Use Helm to roll `orrery-north` back to its last working revision. Afterwards the Deployment `orrery-north` must run image `nginx:1.25` with `2` ready replicas.
2. Write a Helm values file `/home/candidate/exam/q1/south-values.yaml` that sets `replicaCount` to `2` and adds the pod annotation `site: south-ridge` (chart value `podAnnotations`).
3. Install a second release named `orrery-south` from the same local chart into namespace `starmap`, using that values file. Its Deployment `orrery-south` must have `2` ready replicas.

verification.description: orrery-north was rolled back to revision 1 (new revision, status deployed)
Deployment orrery-north runs nginx:1.25 with 2 ready replicas
orrery-south installed from the orrery chart with south-values.yaml (replicaCount 2, podAnnotations.site)
Deployment orrery-south has 2 ready replicas and pod annotation site=south-ridge
